title: Transit giant CRRC sets down marker in Hong Kong as sales pitch to overseas cities
summary:
Nearly 30 years after the closure of Hong Kong’s iconic Kai Tak Airport, state-owned giant China Railway Rolling Stock Corporation (CRRC) hopes to provide the nearby waterfront area – a narrow stretch of land that juts into Victoria Harbour – with a route to better transit connectivity.
Executives from the world-leading railway vehicle manufacturer said the company aims to use the former airport site as a test bed for an autonomous vehicle system, and a potential runway for overseas...
reason: 中国中车（CRRC）作为国有轨道交通巨头，在香港推广其交通解决方案并瞄准海外城市，属于中国企业在海外业务拓展和国际化动态。
